profile.name: MJ Shin
profile.bio: I make cool stuff look cooler

projects.name: dom-cutout
projects.tagline: Cut the silhouette of one DOM element out of another, following its real contour.
projects.blurb: The punch-through badge you've seen on avatar status dots, except nothing is pre-baked. It measures the live DOM, so any overlay shape, size, or position works, and SVG glyphs get traced contour-for-contour rather than boxed. Zero-dependency core, React adapter, stays in sync via ResizeObserver.

projects.name: back-track
projects.tagline: Posture monitoring in the browser, driven by your webcam.
projects.blurb: Tracks 33 body landmarks with MediaPipe Pose and calls out leaning, screen-crowding, and slouching as it happens, with adjustable thresholds and per-session stats. Every frame is processed locally, so no video leaves the machine.
